item.description:
Behold the brand spanking new remastered release from 2nd December 2025 Tom and Jerry: The Golden Era Anthology is a five-disc Blu-ray set. It consists of all 114 Tom and Jerry cartoons created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera presented uncensored, uncut, and in chronological order. It also includes a collectible 32-page booklet with artwork and essays. It was released by Warner Bros. Home Entertainment and the Warner Archive Collection to commemorate the 85th anniversary of the franchise.
